AUTHOR: Gallitto
TITLE: Automatic Extraction and Counting of Fish from Underwater Videos Using YOLO-Based Deep Learning Algorithms
REGION: Sardinia, Italy — MPA Tavolara-Punta Coda Cavallo (Isola Rossa, C zone), 15 m depth, Posidonia oceanica meadows, August 2024
SPECIES: 28 Mediterranean species incl. Oblada melanura, Chromis chromis, Coris julis, Diplodus spp., Spicara maena/smaris, Sarpa salpa, Thalassoma pavo, Serranus scriba, Epinephelus marginatus + 'Afish poly' class
DATA: Own SardinIA dataset: 729 annotated frames from DOVC videos (3 replicate 50-m transects, Becam 4K action camera); baselines DeepFins (OzFish-trained) and DeepEcomar (Labelled Mediterranean Fish Dataset)
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'during August 2024 by scuba operators, at 15 m depth' — depth reported; no turbidity/visibility measure or stratified results
D_EV: Sec. 2.4.2: 'The labelled fish dataset used for YOLOE experiments is randomly divided into training, validation and testing sets in the ratio of 8:1:1.'
R_EV: Sec. 2.3.1: DeepFins 'trained on a dataset composed of fish species from Australian waters' applied to Sardinian frames: 'an accuracy of 0.71, a precision of 0.78, a recall of 0.68, and an F1 score of 0.61'
C_EV: Sec. 2.4.2: 'Under evaluation conditions with IoU = 0.5 and confidence threshold (conf) = 0.4' — single threshold, no sensitivity, calibration or verified false-positive rate
E_EV: Table 2 / Sec. 3: 'The DeepSort-based automated method achieved a total fish count (261) almost identical to DOVC (260)'; compared with 'underwater visual census, UVC and diver operated video census, DOVC'
ARCH: YOLOE (text-prompt, RRTA transfer learning, 80 epochs) and YOLOv8 fine-tuned on SardinIA; baselines DeepFins (YOLOv11 + motion module) and DeepEcomar (YOLOv5m); trackers DeepSORT (selected), ByteTrack, SAMURAI
METR: YOLOE: accuracy 0.763, precision 0.864, recall 0.868, F1 0.866 (conf 0.4, IoU 0.5); YOLOv8: F1 0.70; DeepFins F1 0.61; DeepEcomar F1 0.20; per-species counts vs UVC/DOVC (Table 2)
NOTE: Short workshop paper (peer-reviewed per footer). ENV coded 온대 암반/켈프 as closest allowed value for temperate Mediterranean Posidonia seagrass MPA. Frame-level random 8:1:1 split of frames from three transect videos (D_ALL = N). R1 = Y because pre-existing models trained elsewhere (DeepFins, Australia; DeepEcomar, other Mediterranean data) are evaluated on the Sardinian footage with separate metrics; the authors' own YOLOE model is tested in-domain. E5 = 독립 참조 because automated species counts are compared with diver UVC (independent of the footage) as well as DOVC (human reading of the diver video); whether the detection test frames overlap the counted transect videos is not stated. C_ALL = N: fixed conf 0.4, no threshold sensitivity; false positives on Posidonia leaves and ID-switching are discussed qualitatively only (trackers compared, DeepSORT chosen for 'reducing identity-switching issues' without quantification, so C5 = 없음; verifier may consider 중복계수 처리). Pre-training source of YOLO weights not stated. SardinIA dataset 'available upon request'.
